Read lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex and test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs directly (full files, not diffs) and checked each ISS-0216 acceptance criterion against the real code:

1. check_prefix/2 new leading empty-prefix clause -- CONFIRMED at lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex:236-249: `defp check_prefix(_decoded, "")` raises ArgumentError with a message naming decode_cursor/4, the non-empty-hardcoded-literal precondition, why it matters (String.starts_with?/2's empty-string-always-matches semantics), and a pointer to moduledoc INV-9. The pre-existing clause (lines 251-257, byte_size/starts_with? logic) is unchanged and now second in dispatch order -- confirmed via `git diff --stat 32a8e39 -- lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex` showing 39 insertions, 0 deletions (purely additive commit 2b0d881), so the original clause could not have been altered.

2. @spec unchanged -- CONFIRMED: check_prefix/2's @spec at line 230 is still `:ok | {:error, :wrong_endpoint}` (raise is not part of a @spec return type, correctly omitted); decode_cursor/4's @spec at lines 207-212 and its with-chain body at lines 213-220 are untouched.

3. Moduledoc INV-9 and @doc precondition -- CONFIRMED: moduledoc INV-9 paragraph at lines 31-40 (after INV-8, before the wall-clock-time paragraph); decode_cursor/4's own @doc gains the prefix-precondition paragraph at lines 199-205 explicitly stating prefix must be non-empty/hardcoded/per-endpoint and that an empty prefix raises ArgumentError rather than returning an error tuple.

4. Regression tests present, real, non-skipped, passing -- CONFIRMED at test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs lines 116-134 (describe 'decode_cursor/4 and prefix validation (AC3)'): test 'ISS-0216: an empty prefix raises ArgumentError instead of silently matching' (lines 116-123) asserts assert_raise ArgumentError, ~r/empty prefix/ against a realistically-minted 'T:' cursor decoded with prefix ""; test 'ISS-0216: an empty prefix raises even against a payload with no colons at all' (lines 125-134) asserts the raise fires unconditionally on prefix == "" regardless of decoded's shape, closing the vacuity gap a narrower fix could have left open. Grepped the file: no @tag :skip, no TODO. Both passed in my own isolated run above (40/40, including these two).

Call-site safety -- spot-checked (not re-diagnosing from scratch, since step-01's ISSUE-FIXER grep of all 9 real call sites already confirmed every one passes a hardcoded non-empty module-attribute prefix): re-grepped `grep -rn 'decode_cursor(' lib/letflow` myself and confirm no call site passes an empty string or a request/query/path-derived value -- the fix does not regress any existing caller (also confirmed structurally: full-suite 2064/2064 passed, and none of the 9 route-handler modules' own tests failed).
